label: Immanent primary-object route to subsistent self-understanding
summary: Continuation of merged #1855/#1866/#1873. Reuses the existing q.14 a.1 immaterial-to-intellect reading and POTENCY_3 capacity / POTENCY_2 exercise-or-potency route with pure act to derive an actually exercised source intellect. A new immanent-primary-form interpretation distinguishes the form immediately actualizing that intellect, identity with the own subsistent essence, self-directed primary aboutness, and actual intentional apprehension. Conditional Lean theorem obtains source-level IntrinsicSelfKnowledge under an explicit interpretation of grounding by its own form; does not assume WisdomSelfCapacity or TrueSelfApprehensionGrounded. Three finite controls distinguish an impersonal source with genuinely cognitive effects, an actually thinking source whose own form is not self-directed in the model, and a joint positive interpretation. Details, cumulative same-source graph, provisional assessment and revision conditions in docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md#immanent-primary-object-and-subsistent-self-presence-2026-11-23-continuation-of-185518661873. Additional research cross-check: prior registered Round5Worklist.UnderstandingIsThroughIntelligibleForm is weaker (some form given an existing Understands object), so the newly opened immediate-species condition cannot silently reuse it. The strongest *source-backed* supra-noetic rival is Plotinus's One, where absolute unity motivates denial of ordinary noesis yet V.4.2 permits qualified as-if awareness; the precise test is whether intentional subject/object descriptions introduce real multiplicity or only distinct descriptions of one simple act.
blocker: Philosophically open q.14 immateriality-to-intellect, POTENCY_3→POTENCY_2 with formal actual intellectual exercise, source's primary intelligible form necessarily being its own essence and about itself, immanent act's cognition of that form, grounding-sense recognition, and content-sensitive exemplary knowledge of contingent effects. Formal models are structural only. Independent final semantic review and final-head CI required. Plotinian real-articulation-versus-intentional-distinction test at the first source, common Being/GOD_4 domain bridge, and potential POTENCY/IN_ACT sense distinction unresolved.
